title: Assistant
subtitle: Find resources, get study advice, draft and adjust study plans — within this library only.

boundary.text: I only cover resource search, study advice and study plans. Writing or debugging code, translation and general knowledge are out of scope.

guide.title: No model configured yet
guide.body: Greetings, searching and refusals cost no tokens and already work. Drafting plans and giving advice need base_url / api_key / model on the settings page.

empty.title: Try one of these
empty.note: Picking a card fills the prompt into the box so you can edit it first.

plan.label: Draft a plan
plan.prompt: Make me a 12-week frontend plan at 10 hours a week
plan.hint: Routed to plan drafting; returns a savable draft

search.label: Find resources
search.hint: Routed to search; returns in-library result cards

advice.label: Ask for advice
advice.prompt: I'm a complete beginner — what should I learn first for frontend?
advice.hint: Routed to advice; answers citing in-library resources

refusal.label: Out of scope
refusal.hint: Routed to refusal; fixed wording plus a better question

intent.hint: The intent is decided on the server (rules first, then the model); it cannot be corrected from this page yet

bubble.truncated: The answer hit the length limit and was truncated

composer.label: Type your question
composer.placeholder: Ask something, e.g. "Any articles on closures?"
composer.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line; over 500 characters is truncated

search.head: {{total}} resources matched "{{query}}"
search.note: Pick one to open it; results come from the in-library full-text index.
search.emptyNote: Try another wording, or browse the library by stack.

clarify.hint: Pick one to fill the prompt, then press Send.

plan.meta: {{weeks}} weeks · {{hours}} h/week · {{stages}} stages · {{items}} items · about {{minutes}} minutes
plan.note: Saving writes to the database and makes it the active plan; use "Preview and edit" to change stages first.
plan.summarySaved: Drafted "{{title}}" ({{stages}} stages / {{items}} items / about {{hours}} h) and saved it to your plans
plan.summarySaving: Drafted "{{title}}" ({{stages}} stages / {{items}} items / about {{hours}} h) — saving it to your plans…
plan.summaryFailed: Drafted "{{title}}" ({{stages}} stages / {{items}} items / about {{hours}} h) — saving failed, the draft is still here

error.title: That didn't work
error.networkHint: Check that the local service is still running; the answer may be cut off — retrying asks again
